items.Sentence: Each comfort station discharges wastewater into four 9,000-gallon onsite concrete septic tanks.
The combined effluent gravity flows to the facultative wastewater treatment pond (Primary Treatment Pond), which is Hypalon lined (30-millimeter) and has three evenly spaced aerators.
Wastewater from the Primary Treatment Pond is discharged to four infiltration ponds (Infiltration Ponds) all constructed in 1981 when the rest area was initially opened.
